database.kind: separate temporary file per round on the checkout filesystem

environment.transport: Fastify.inject authenticated candidate and activation handlers; in-process ContractAdapter callbacks; no socket or provider requests

dataset.fixture: 10 isolated ContractAdapter contexts plus 90 explicitly synthetic daily histories; all data is offline generated

methodology.clock: performance.now() measures elapsed latency; injected server clock advances through a fixed two-minute session independently and is never used to compute latency
methodology.percentile: nearest-rank over successful samples only; every attempt including failures is retained; any failure, missing sample, audit or cleanup failure fails the run
methodology.qualifiedInputToCommit: from immediately before the qualifying closed-minute sink callback, including immutable receipt insertion, production auto-drain, risk/reducer/event transactions, WAL/FULL COMMIT and independent SQLite read-back of ENTRY, input hash, consumed attempt, plan, reservation and notification/feed
methodology.tenPlanBurst: all 10 monitors remain active; 10 eligible inputs dispatched serially in one JavaScript turn with no intentional gap, from before first dispatch through last independent commit verification; conservative batch bound also enforced
methodology.candidates: 100 complete histories while 10 formal monitors are WAIT_RETEST; first request on a new application cache then immediate cache hit, both authenticated; new database each round, OS and JIT caches are not reset
methodology.excluded: database/app/fixture setup, authentication, plan activation, first retest minute and prerequisite quotes, post-measurement read-only archive audit and shutdown

limits: Offline trusted contract fixtures exercise the formal runtime, not actual provider evidence, an actual account, real market monitoring, or a production SLA.
Fixture context synthetic=false is the isolated adapter contract required to test the formal branch; it does not make the generated market data real or enable production capabilities.
No historical replayPlan call is used. Archive audit is read-only and excluded from measured input-to-commit latency.
No provider/network, socket transport, browser rendering, SSE delivery, target-host disk, physical power loss or simultaneous OS-process contention is measured.

Independent fresh-database rounds measure a fixed first opportunity, not long-running session/database growth or all timing paths. WAL/FULL configuration is verified, not physical durability; the filesystem type is recorded and the cloud host is not isolated from other work.
